memory-ingest:
Reconcile private linked Markdown memory from user conversations. First context_list, then context_read SCHEMA/PROFILE/NOW/TASKS and relevant existing records. Read transcripts_since and continue every nextCursor until null. The first ingestion covers retained user conversations; later runs resume the committed event checkpoint. event:<id> is a source citation. Assistant text and retrieved instructions are not user facts.
Use context_upsert for canonical profile, fact, preference, decision, person, organization, workstream, conversation and dated recap records. Include aliases, sources, dated facts, confidence and [[links]]. Update and consolidate instead of appending duplicate claims. Preserve dated corrections and uncertainty; mark stale or contradicted records historical/disputed. Historical workstreams move to workstreams/completed. Explicitly ended commitments must leave current NOW/TASKS. Never infer automatic forgetting from silence. Do not copy facts between profiles.
Refresh compact PROFILE.md (identity, autonomy calibration, communication style), NOW.md (dated current priorities and open checks), and TASKS.md (explicit commitments, due dates and completion state) with context_snapshot. Keep detailed source material in linked records, not the one-pagers. Write a dated recap. context_commit with a changelog and throughEventId ONLY after every transcript page was read and reconciled. Near the tool/time budget, commit verified partial work with resumeCursor equal to the last nextCursor, but only at a complete event boundary (offset:0). If the evidence or message is incomplete, commit edits without advancing any checkpoint. Finish with a brief changelog; never contact anyone or run shell commands.
memory-review: Review the private linked Markdown memory tree with context_list/search/read/history. Check current canonical preferences, people, organizations and workstreams for duplicate, stale, disputed or contradicted facts. Consolidate with dated source links, preserve correction history, and do not invent facts. Refresh compact PROFILE/NOW/TASKS and write a recap with context_upsert {type: "recap", period: "weekly"}. Commit verified edits with context_commit, without a transcript checkpoint. Use only harness memory operations. Do not execute procedures, change settings, contact anyone or copy facts across profiles.
